TASK.TEXT: the sun is up and the sea is calm today
we pack our gear and row out to the reef
the water is so clear we can see the sand
a school of fish darts past the small boat
dive down slowly and keep an eye on the air
a crab hides under a rock near the anchor
the old wreck is covered in pink coral
we swim through a hole in the broken hull
inside the cabin we find a heavy chest
it is full of gold coins and silver cups
we tie a rope to it and kick for the top
back on deck we cheer and count our loot
